source: Crusoe press release: Crusoe Partners with Araico on AI Cloud in Paraguay (10-22-2026)

quarterly_data.signal: Partner Araico (Paraguay): Crusoe announced a strategic partnership with Paraguayan energy and infrastructure developer Araico to build AI compute infrastructure powered by the Itaipu Hydroelectric Dam, its first dedicated AI Cloud deployment in Latin America; Crusoe plans an initial deployment online in mid-2027, with a path to 106 MW of IT capacity and long-term options to expand to approximately 280 MW total, serving U.S. cloud customers and Latin American demand through Crusoe Cloud. Araico leads local development and site infrastructure adjacent to the Itaipu substation; Crusoe manages, operates and delivers the compute.
quarterly_data.figure: initial deployment mid-2027; path to 106 MW IT; options to approximately 280 MW
